review_candidates.title: System Administrator—Customer Deployments
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Summary Conexus is seeking a system administrator to deploy, maintain, and support secure, on-premises systems in customer environments. This is primarily a field-focused role, and the system administrator serves as the technical link between Conexus and customer IT teams, ensuring our solutions are successfully deployed and supported throughout their lifecycle. Between deployments, the system administrator supports Conexus's internal IT infrastructure and cybersecurity operations. A success
eligibility_evidence: ·     Coordinate deployments and technical changes with customer stakeholders and build strong working relationships with on-site IT and security staff.
Travel Requirements ·     Frequent domestic and international travel is a core requirement of this position.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: A successful system administrator is technically fluent, self-directed, and able to turn loosely defined requirements into practical solutions with minimal oversight. ResponsibilitiesSite Deployments and Sustainment ·     Develop deep expertise in Conexus software and hardware. ·     Ensure Conexus systems meet applicable customer cybersecurity requirements, and clearly communicate them to customer IT teams. QualificationsRequired ·     3+ years of experience in IT systems support, system administration, application administration, cybersecurity, or a similar technical role. ·     Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical requirements to customer IT teams and non-technical stakeholders. Travel Requirements ·     Frequent domestic and international travel is a core requirement of this position.
